reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 1771 for N = 10626. Lower bound is an independent set of size 1771 (independent_set check true); upper bound is a linear code M = I + A over F_2 (p = 2, c = 1) whose length meets 1771, with code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all true. Only 1 code was tried, after 2 LLM calls and 1 critic round. Time: wall 43.092 s, of which LLM 28.424 s and compute 14.668 s, so LLM time dominated. No baselines were run, so no accuracy or speed comparison can be claimed. Caveat: the Kneser hypothesis left params empty and the spectrum was not computed (N > 4000), but the certificate is independent of the hypothesis. own_rank is unavailable since N > 2500.
